scope: Chrome sets itself up the first time you open the web.

topics.title: Chrome sets itself up
details: The first time you open Web browser or YouTube, Companion sets up Chrome for you.
It installs Chrome if needed, adds the Voice Companion extension, and links Chrome.
You may need to press Enable extension once in Chrome. Companion tells you how.
Then the web or YouTube opens, in your own Chrome.

topics.title: Set up Chrome is still there
details: To set up Chrome later, or again, say set up Chrome.
If you say cancel during the first setup, Companion does not set it up again by itself.
